select T1.ISSUE_AMT/10000 ISSUE_AMT,
,T2.IS_SEC_BOND, T2.bid_date bidDate, T2.IS_AUTO_UPDATE,
T2.FACE_VALUE, T3.TYPE_4, T3.TYPE_5,
T3.TYPE_9, T3.TYPE_10, T3.TYPE_11, T3.TYPE_12,
T4.CALENDAR_NAME, T5.CUSTOMER_NAME ISSUER_NAME, T6.REP_REGISTORG_COMMENT repRegistorgComment, T.PFLSH pflsh, T.HAP_CREDIT_AMT hapCreditAmt, T.CREDIT_FLAG creditFlag, T9.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID actualCreditProvid, T1.ISSUER issuer from FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T8.FINPROD_ID,T7.CREDIT_FLAG ,T7.PFLSH,T7.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T7.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES T7 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T8 ON T7.CUSTOMER_ID = T8.SEQNO) T ON (T.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID OR T.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID) left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T2 on T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 on T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO T4 on T4.CALENDAR_ID = T1.CALENDAR_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 on T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.ISSUER left join REP_ASSET_BOND T6 on T6.REP_FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T9 on T9.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT count( * ) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
